name: Ikaros – AI Manifest & Bot Optimizer
author: Ikaros Ai

sections.description:
Ikaros AI Manifest is a WooCommerce plugin that integrates with AI agents through structured data and AI discovery endpoints. It serves .well-known/ai-commerce.json, provides bot analytics, and exposes product catalog data for AI discovery workflows.

What it does:
* Serves .well-known/ai-commerce.json manifest for AI agent discovery
* Implements Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI tool integration
* Implements Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) for AI shopping capabilities
* Uses Google Gemini API to generate product summaries (explicit user action only)
* Adds structured data (JSON-LD) to product pages with generated content
* Detects and logs interactions from known AI crawlers (Google, Perplexity, Claude, etc.) when tracking is enabled
* Provides a Dashboard with visibility score, category breakdown, trending bots, and endpoint insights
* Provides Analytics with date ranges, intent classification, bot distribution, and activity log
* Adds AI Readiness Score to WooCommerce product list (column, sorting, filtering, bulk recalculation)
* Provides unified Settings (API, language, policy controls, and integrated Pro settings when Pro is active)

Requirements:
* Valid Google Gemini API key
* WooCommerce 6.0+
* WordPress 6.0+
* PHP 7.4+

How to configure:
1. Install and activate the plugin
2. Go to Ikaros AI → Settings
3. Enter your Google Gemini API key
4. In the product editor, click “Generate Summary” to create AI-generated product descriptions
5. (Optional) Enable Bot activity tracking in Ikaros AI → Settings → Features
6. Open Ikaros AI → Dashboard for visibility and bot overview metrics
7. Open Ikaros AI → Analytics for detailed activity, intent, charts, and exports
8. The plugin automatically adds generated content to your product metadata and structured data

Data collection:
This plugin can log when known AI crawlers visit your shop. Logging is disabled by default and can be enabled in Settings → Features.

Stored fields in bot logs:
* Bot name (detected from user agent)
* User agent string (truncated)
* Visited endpoint/path
* Request method
* Timestamp
* Product ID (when applicable)

Cookie usage:
* ikaros_bot_ref (30 days) may be set when AI-assisted buy links are used, to support AI-attributed checkout flows.

No analytics JavaScript or third-party tracking pixels are injected on the frontend by this plugin.

Site owners are responsible for configuring consent/privacy notices as required by local law.

External services

This plugin utilizes the Google Gemini API to generate product summaries and descriptions.
* Service: Google Gemini API
* Usage: Used only when you click “Generate” in the product editor.
* Data Sent: Product title, product description context, selected model identifier, and API request metadata needed to generate text output.
* Terms of Service: Google Generative AI Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ikaros-ai-manifest directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Ikaros AI settings page to enter your Google Gemini API Key.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Added: Dashboard page for AI visibility, bot category analysis, and top endpoint/product insights.
  • Added: Analytics page enhancements (date range filtering, bot intent classification, activity table, charts, CSV export).
  • Added: AI Readiness Score in product list (sortable/filterable column + bulk recalculate action).
  • Changed: Renamed “Intelligence” section to “Dashboard”.
  • Changed: Consolidated free settings and policy controls into one unified Settings page.
  • Security: Strengthened nonce validation and request hardening for admin/AJAX flows.

1.1.1

  • Security: Removed API key exposure from JavaScript; keys now only transmitted via AJAX POST.
  • Security: Added null check for product object in schema injection function.
  • Security: Fixed database query preparation for bot log retrieval.
  • Compliance: Removed feature gating on bot statistics charts (now always visible to all users).
  • UX: Added emoji icons to admin menu and submenus.

1.1.0

  • Feature: Added support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI Agents.
  • Feature: Added Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) Discovery endpoint.
  • Fix: Improved security by replacing strip_tags with wp_strip_all_tags.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
